zoe_h: quick RFC follow-up: propose tightening the safetensors warmup contract so runtime never sees partially-mapped shards. sketch of fallback options below.

omar_k: sgtm. what are the fallback options?

zoe_h: 1) prefer compatible compact/quantized variant declared in manifest; 2) route to spare-node pool; 3) if customer policy allows, provide a read-only shim for small tables. default: prefer (1) then (2), shim off for pinned models.

paul_r: define compatible in manifest: same keys + compatible ordering + optional dequant shim info. add `compat_tags` and `eval_hash` fields.

omar_k: avoid fallback thundering herd: token-bucket per-model hotstart credits + exponential backoff.

zoe_h: telemetry fields: hotstart.result={ok|fallback|shim|timeout|corrupt}, requested_shards, fetched_shards, fallback_reason. alert when fallback_rate>0.1% for pinned models.

paul_r: tests: unit flows for happy, timeout->fallback, corrupt->fallback, shim-swap. add small s3mock e2e in CI.

ci-bot: CI: model-warmup-tests passed (28s) :white_check_mark:

zoe_h: action: i'll update manifest docs and add HotstartPolicy enum (ATOMIC_BLOCKING, IMMEDIATE_FALLBACK, ALLOW_SHIM). thanks.
